name: SAR Televenture Ltd.
summary: SAR Televenture Ltd. is an Indian telecommunication infrastructure company providing integrated solutions primarily to telecom network operators, broadband service providers, and enterprises. The company specializes in the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and leasing of 4G and 5G network towers and optical fiber cable systems across India. Its offerings include various tower infrastructures, such as ground-based, monopoles, and cell-on-wheels towers, along with Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) solutions for residential and commercial developments. Additionally, SAR Televenture provides smart systems and digital connectivity solutions, including smart home automation, smart prepaid meters, video door phones, intercom systems, and security management solutions like CCTV, access control, and fire alarms. The company also trades in network equipment and offers project management and support services for fiber optic cable deployment and network maintenance. SAR Televenture operates as an Infrastructure Provider Category-I (IP-I) and contributes to India's digital transformation and 5G infrastructure expansion.
